analysis_semantics.note: Software preflight and synthetic/replay evidence do not establish clinical accuracy, effectiveness, safety or patient outcomes.

hard_stops: Stop if intended use, excluded use, population or non-interventional scope is ambiguous.
Stop if accountable clinical, technical, governance or incident roles are not named and separated.
Stop on unresolved privacy leakage, missing consent/waiver, retention ambiguity or unsafe access/export boundary.
Stop if stop, incident, escalation, rollback or manual fallback cannot be executed and evidenced.
Stop if backup/restore and recovery evidence is absent or only inferred from software simulation.
Stop if device, host, clock, network, power-loss or recovery qualification is incomplete.
Stop if real identity transport, mTLS/IdP, HIS acknowledgment or integration evidence is absent.
Stop if staff can interpret a shadow signal as diagnosis/treatment or human-factors review is incomplete.
Stop if independent review, analysis denominator, review coverage or missed-event handling is incomplete.
Stop if any system or local operator attempts automatic promotion to clinical treatment workflow.

CV-001.required_state: decision-support scope and excluded clinical actions are explicit
CV-001.stop_condition: Stop if intended use, excluded use, population or non-interventional scope is ambiguous.
CV-001.title: intended use and excluded use

CV-002.evidence_required: named accountable owners and signed governance approval
CV-002.required_state: clinical/technical owners, governance and escalation roles are assigned
CV-002.stop_condition: Stop if accountable clinical, technical, governance or incident roles are not named and separated.
CV-002.title: owners and governance

CV-003.required_state: privacy/security review, consent or waiver and retention decision are required
CV-003.stop_condition: Stop on unresolved privacy leakage, missing consent/waiver, retention ambiguity or unsafe access/export boundary.
CV-003.title: privacy, consent and retention

CV-004.evidence_required: approved safety protocol and fallback drill
CV-004.required_state: stop, incident, rollback, manual fallback and escalation paths are required
CV-004.stop_condition: Stop if stop, incident, escalation, rollback or manual fallback cannot be executed and evidenced.
CV-004.title: operational safety and fallback

CV-005.required_state: backup/restore evidence is a prerequisite and not inferred from code tests
CV-005.stop_condition: Stop if backup/restore and recovery evidence is absent or only inferred from software simulation.
CV-005.title: backup and recovery

CV-006.required_state: device, clock, host and recovery qualification remain external
CV-006.stop_condition: Stop if device, host, clock, network, power-loss or recovery qualification is incomplete.
CV-006.title: device and host qualification

CV-007.required_state: auth/mTLS/IdP and HIS acknowledgment are required before real evaluation
CV-007.stop_condition: Stop if real identity transport, mTLS/IdP, HIS acknowledgment or integration evidence is absent.
CV-007.title: identity, transport and HIS

CV-008.required_state: staff walkthrough, wording, alarm-fatigue and no-treatment-order interpretation are required
CV-008.stop_condition: Stop if staff can interpret a shadow signal as diagnosis/treatment or human-factors review is incomplete.
CV-008.title: training and human factors

CV-009.evidence_required: approved analysis plan and adjudication owner
CV-009.required_state: independent review plan and non-accuracy analysis semantics are required
CV-009.stop_condition: Stop if independent review, analysis denominator, review coverage or missed-event handling is incomplete.
CV-009.title: independent review and analysis

CV-010.required_state: continue/modify/pause/reject requires governance decision; no automatic treatment promotion
CV-010.stop_condition: Stop if any system or local operator attempts automatic promotion to clinical treatment workflow.
CV-010.title: decision and promotion gate
